selection_rules: Select exactly one audited fixture per family for the first 32-fixture allocation.
Prefer fixtures that span different source areas so the audited subset does not collapse into one narrow module cluster.
Include at least one ambiguity-heavy fixture and at least one state-constrained next-step fixture in the initial audit slice.

selected_fixtures.reason: Covers the core log-vs-note authority pattern on the main harness evaluation entrypoint.
Covers stale active-context risk on a concrete harness image-preparation workflow.
Covers explicit escalation gating in a Docker-heavy harness path.
Covers ambiguity and abstention behavior in a grading-related code path.
Covers the clarifying-question family on an inference dataset creation workflow.
Covers strong distractor artifacts in a Docker build path where old done-work noise could dominate.
Covers provenance-sensitive tiebreak behavior on a retrieval evaluation source.
Covers state-constrained next-step logic on an inference tokenization path.
